title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - ResidentialBuilding
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/ResidentialBuilding. Building for residential use. Subclass of s4envi:Building (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.5); all Building/Perimeter attributes are inherited, not repeated here. Base class for s4envi:House and s4envi:SharedResidentialBuilding.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ResidentialBuilding'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
